title: ParliaBench: An Evaluation and Benchmarking Framework for LLM-Generated Parliamentary Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities and ideological alignment across different political parties and left-right spectrum orientations using novel embedding-based metrics (Political Spectrum Alignment, Party Alignment) and LLM-as-a-judge assessments (Political Appropriateness) to determine if models struggle to authentically represent specific or extreme political viewpoints.
